name: renvor-docs
description: Renvor documentation site. Not published to any registry.

overrides: serialize-javascript: forced to ^7.1.0 to close GHSA-5c6j-r48x-rmvq (high, RCE via
RegExp.flags, CVSS 8.1) and GHSA-qj8w-gfj5-8c6v (moderate, CPU-exhaustion DoS).
Reached through copy-webpack-plugin 11 and css-minimizer-webpack-plugin 5, both of
which Docusaurus 3.10.2 pins to majors that require serialize-javascript ^6. Only
copy-webpack-plugin 14 and css-minimizer-webpack-plugin 8 moved to ^7.0.3, and both
are outside the ranges Docusaurus declares, so no compatible ordinary update exists.
The override is safe to force: 7.x keeps the same CommonJS shape as 6.0.2 (type
commonjs, main index.js, no exports map) and only raises engines to node >=20, which
.nvmrc already satisfies at 22. Verified by a frozen install, a production build, and
a link check.
Remove when: Docusaurus ships a release whose bundler depends on plugin majors that
already carry serialize-javascript ^7.
uuid: forced to ^11.1.1 to close GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq (moderate, missing buffer bounds
check in v3/v5/v6 when the caller supplies `buf`). Reached only through sockjs 0.3.24,
which arrives with webpack-dev-server, so it is a dev-server path that never enters a
production build. sockjs pins uuid ^8.3.2 and has not published since 2021, so no
ordinary update reaches the patched line. The override is safe to force: sockjs's only
use is `require('uuid').v4` in lib/transport.js, and uuid 11.1.1 — despite being
ESM-first — still ships a CommonJS build (main ./dist/cjs/index.js, and an exports map
whose node.require condition resolves there), so that named export resolves unchanged.
Verified by requiring sockjs and sockjs/lib/transport.js under 11.1.1 and generating a
v4, plus a frozen install and a dev-server boot serving HTTP 200. Took 3 moderate audit
findings to zero.
Remove when: sockjs ships a release depending on uuid >= 11.1.1, or webpack-dev-server
drops sockjs.
image-size: redirected to the local no-op in vendor/image-size-disabled to close
GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr and GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq (both high, CVSS 7.5 — infinite loops in
the ICNS, JXL and HEIF parsers). Unlike the entries above this is not a version bump,
because there is no version to bump to: both advisories cover <=2.0.2, 2.0.2 is the
latest published release, and upstream is archived. Docusaurus 3.10.2 is likewise the
latest release, so no ordinary update on either side drops the dependency. The override
uses npm's `$image-size` form, which resolves the spec from this file's dependencies; a
bare `file:` spec in the override resolves relative to the dependent package instead and
breaks `npm ci`.
The redirect is safe because the API surface is a single function. The only importer in
the entire tree is @docusaurus/mdx-loader, which does require('image-size/fromFile') and
awaits imageSizeFromFile(path) to stamp width/height onto images referenced from MDX.
The replacement exports that name — and mirrors the rest of the real export map — and
throws rather than returning empty dimensions, so a call is loud instead of silently
dimensionless; mdx-loader already wraps it in try/catch and logs. Nothing calls it
today: the site embeds no images beyond static/img/favicon.ico, which is copied as
bytes and never parsed.
Behaviour change: this site can no longer measure images, so adding one would omit
width/height and shift layout. That is enforced, not left to memory — the prebuild
guard scripts/check-image-inputs.mjs fails the build on any image input. Verified by a
frozen install, a production build emitting all 7 pages, a dev-server boot, the guard
rejecting both a raster asset and an MDX embed, and the vulnerable parsers being absent
from node_modules. Took 18 high audit findings to zero.
Remove when: a maintained image-size exists, or Docusaurus stops needing one. Restore
the real package, drop this override, the `image-size` dependency entry and the vendored
directory, and retire scripts/check-image-inputs.mjs in the same change — the guard and
the override only make sense together.
